title.narrative: National Multi Donor Trust Fund for North Sudan (MDTF NS)

description.narrative: The objective of the trust fund is to provide a vehicle for Donors to pool resources and coordinate support to fund the overall reconstruction and development needs of Sudan during the interim period. The focus will be on recovery and long term development activities to support Sudan's reaching of the Millennium Developement Goals.
